name: Short-Stay Visa (Type C) / Schengen Short Stay

requirements.blocker_text: Passport valid at least 3 months beyond the intended departure date, issued within the last 10 years, per standard Schengen requirements.
Documented purpose of visit and proof of sufficient funds for the stay.

outcome.duration_length: up to 90 days in any 180-day period (Schengen short-stay)
